ff15563f9eec144830eba93bfdeb27da.overview: A cover-up that spanned four U.S. Presidents pushed the country's first female newspaper publisher and a hard-driving editor to join an unprecedented battle between journalist and government. Inspired by true events.

ff2b0b1d4bff0ccc086f58e426ef4cdb.overview: The vaudeville act of Harriet and Queenie Mahoney comes to Broadway, where their friend Eddie Kerns needs them for his number in one of Francis Zanfield's shows. When Eddie meets Queenie, he soon falls in love with  her—but she is already being courted by Jock Warriner, a member of New York high society. Queenie eventually recognizes that, to Jock, she is nothing more than a toy, and that Eddie is in love with her.
ff2b0b1d4bff0ccc086f58e426ef4cdb.tagline: All talking. All singing. All dancing.

ff3b982884c1ab8e9d5be8b6be4752c6.overview: Tom Ripley is a calculating young man who believes it's better to be a fake somebody than a real nobody. Opportunity knocks in the form of a wealthy U.S. shipbuilder who hires Tom to travel to Italy to bring back his playboy son, Dickie. Ripley worms his way into the idyllic lives of Dickie and his girlfriend, plunging into a daring scheme of duplicity, lies and murder.
ff3b982884c1ab8e9d5be8b6be4752c6.tagline: How far would you go to become someone else.

ff42cad29e853a8fd17a12f7f0123a9b.overview: After a flight back home, Sam Hendrix returns with a doll he innocently acquired along the way. As it turns out, the doll is actually stuffed with heroin, and a group of criminals led by the ruthless Roat has followed Hendrix back to his place to retrieve it. When Hendrix leaves for business, the crooks make their move -- and find his blind wife, Susy, alone in the apartment. Soon, a life-threatening game begins between Susy and the thugs.
ff42cad29e853a8fd17a12f7f0123a9b.tagline: A blind woman plays a deadly game of survival.

ff8f74412088efbb2919702d12fcb322.overview: On April 24, 1924, the movies changed forever: The Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer studio opened and soon assembled “more stars than there are in the heavens.” Patrick Stewart hosts this enthralling Emmy® winner as Outstanding Informational Series, a three-part story of M-G-M’s reign as Hollywood’s class act and legendary entertainment empire. Bursting with memorable film clips, rare interviews, behind-the-scenes footage and insider info, this is a mother lode for film fans, profiling perfectionist moguls, glamorous and charismatic actors, innovative filmmakers and landmark movies.

ff9ac9e3131a81e5b3ef3ae34bc1c786.overview: When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, NASA honcho Dan Truman determines the only way to stop it is to drill into its surface and detonate a nuclear bomb. This leads him to renowned driller Harry Stamper, who agrees to helm the dangerous space mission provided he can bring along his own hotshot crew. Among them is the cocksure A.J. who Harry thinks isn't good enough for his daughter, until the mission proves otherwise.
ff9ac9e3131a81e5b3ef3ae34bc1c786.tagline: For love. For honor. For mankind.

ffa7a5c4da857f3d2c11dbed723530d6.overview: A documentary that follows Dr. Penny Patterson's current scientific study of Koko, a gorilla who communicates through American Sign Language.

ffc370af203b0cf1a0dd57f5a3df1790.overview: A stern Russian woman sent to Paris on official business finds herself attracted to a man who represents everything she is supposed to detest.

ffd12da6fc42158f9e621ea1129b9cef.overview: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?
ffd12da6fc42158f9e621ea1129b9cef.tagline: Your future is in its hands.

ffd32d90e3df075e7a5b68e0dc430d7b.overview: Catalan architect Antonio Gaudí (1852-1926) designed some of the world's most astonishing buildings, interiors, and parks; Japanese director Hiroshi Teshigahara constructed some of the most aesthetically audacious films ever made. With camera work as bold and sensual as the curves of his subject's organic structures, Teshigahara immortalizes Gaudí on film.

ffd4ec18e30a3e55784d1be142586a1d.overview: A graduate student and obsessive runner in New York is drawn into a mysterious plot involving his brother, a member of the secretive Division.
ffd4ec18e30a3e55784d1be142586a1d.tagline: One man's dangerous attempts to clear his father's name

ffdd8e2f1981d771eb4535e22e069cf5.overview: After losing his job at a coffee shop, Charlie Rogers finds employment at a struggling carnival, but his attempted romance with a teenager leads to friction with her father.
ffdd8e2f1981d771eb4535e22e069cf5.tagline: Elvis Presley as a Roving, Restless, Reckless, ROUSTABOUT
